prompt:
You are one of 3 agents on a team led by an orchestrator. You do ONLY your assigned subtask.
The orchestrator will see your output beside the other two agents' and will assemble the final answer.
Do your part completely and state plainly anything you could not settle, so the orchestrator can.

YOUR SUBTASK (2 of 3): Assertion graph: claim and evidence summary
Write ONLY the sub:assertion { ... } named graph in TriG (assume prefixes from the shared list: rdfs, dct, delphi, schema, sub, etc.). Contents: a delphi:Claim at <https://w3id.org/delphi/resource/claim/composite-never-beat-its-strongest-term> with one quotable-sentence rdfs:label (the composite rank_score has never beaten its own strongest single term, the joint Mahalanobis term, on primary endpoint P1), a dct:description that (1) states the finding's STATUS in words (e.g. observed on the blind held-out run of v1.3.0 only, evaluator independent, a measured result not a proof; dev results count for nothing) and (2) states what it does NOT establish (not a claim about other scorer versions, other endpoints, secondary endpoints S4/S5 where other components matter, causal reasons, or future data), and delphi:hasEvidence <https://w3id.org/delphi/resource/evidence/composite-never-beat-its-strongest-term>. Also write the evidence node header: a delphi:EvidenceItem at that IRI with rdfs:label, dct:description (cite locators sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:13, :14, :33, :35, :36, :38, :43 inline where facts come from), and schema:additionalProperty links to property nodes named sub:pv-nn-diff, sub:pv-vs-joint, sub:pv-all-items, sub:pv-joint-p1, sub:pv-families, sub:pv-version, sub:pv-secondary (another agent defines those nodes; you only link them). Dossier facts: 168 held-out families scored family-out (line 14); v1.3.0 rank_score beats nearest-neighbour distance on P1: 0.875, diff +0.032, CI 0.026 to 0.040 (line 33); does NOT beat joint Mahalanobis alone on P1: diff -0.008, CI -0.020 to 0.002 (line 35); over all held-out items composite significantly worse than joint alone: -0.007, CI -0.013 to -0.002 (line 36); joint alone reaches P1 0.883 and passes all three primary endpoints (line 38); other components earn place only on secondary endpoints S4 and S5 which joint alone fails (line 43); evaluator built neither scorer nor benchmark (line 13). Only numbers allowed anywhere: 168, 0.875, 0.032, 0.026, 0.040, 0.008, 0.020, 0.002, 0.007, 0.013, 0.883, 1.3.0, 4, 5 (note 'three' only in words). Wording must be unique to this finding, no boilerplate. Output just the TriG text of the graph.

TASK: write ONE unsigned nanopublication draft (TriG) recording the finding below.

THE FINDING IN ONE LINE
The design scorer's composite has never beaten its own strongest single term on the primary ranking endpoint.

THE DOSSIER. These are the only facts you have. Each carries its LOCATOR, which is how a reader finds it again.
  [1] locator: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:14
      fact: Every number is from the blind held-out run of each scorer version: 168 held-out families, scored family-out.
  [2] locator: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:33
      fact: v1.3.0 rank_score beats nearest-neighbour distance on endpoint P1: 0.875, difference +0.032, CI 0.026 to 0.040.
  [3] locator: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:35
      fact: rank_score does NOT beat its own joint Mahalanobis term used alone on P1: difference -0.008, CI -0.020 to 0.002.
  [4] locator: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:36
      fact: Over all held-out items the composite is significantly WORSE than the joint term alone: -0.007, CI -0.013 to -0.002.
  [5] locator: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:38
      fact: The joint Mahalanobis term used alone reaches P1 0.883 and passes all three primary endpoints by itself.
  [6] locator: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:43
      fact: The other components earn their place only on secondary endpoints S4 and S5, which the joint term alone fails.
  [7] locator: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:13
      fact: The evaluation was run by an evaluator who built neither the scorer nor the benchmark; dev results count for nothing.

The only numeric literals you may write are these: 168, 0.875, 0.032, 0.026, 0.040, 0.008, 0.020, 0.002, 0.007, 0.013, 0.883, 1.3.0, 4, 5. Any other number is an invention.

REQUIRED SHAPE. Use exactly these prefixes, verbatim:
@prefix this: <http://purl.org/nanopub/temp/np1/> .
@prefix sub: <http://purl.org/nanopub/temp/np1/> .
@prefix np: <http://www.nanopub.org/nschema#> .
@prefix npx: <http://purl.org/nanopub/x/> .
@prefix nt: <https://w3id.org/np/o/ntemplate/> .
@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/> .
@prefix prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> .
@prefix schema: <https://schema.org/> .
@prefix spdx: <http://spdx.org/rdf/terms#> .
@prefix delphi: <https://w3id.org/delphi/ontology/> .

Then four named graphs: sub:Head (this: a np:Nanopublication with np:hasAssertion sub:assertion,
np:hasProvenance sub:provenance, np:hasPublicationInfo sub:pubinfo), sub:assertion, sub:provenance, sub:pubinfo.
In sub:assertion put a delphi:Claim at
  <https://w3id.org/delphi/resource/claim/composite-never-beat-its-strongest-term>
with rdfs:label (one quotable sentence), dct:description, delphi:hasEvidence pointing at a delphi:EvidenceItem at
  <https://w3id.org/delphi/resource/evidence/composite-never-beat-its-strongest-term>
which itself carries rdfs:label, dct:description and one schema:additionalProperty / schema:PropertyValue node
per number you report (schema:propertyID, schema:value, schema:description).
In sub:provenance: sub:assertion prov:wasAttributedTo an agent IRI and prov:wasDerivedFrom the locators.
In sub:pubinfo: dct:created (an xsd:dateTime), dct:creator, an rdfs:label beginning "Draft: ",
dct:license <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/>, npx:hasNanopubType delphi:Claim,
npx:introduces the claim IRI, delphi:domain <https://w3id.org/delphi/resource/domain/design-scorer-evaluation>
with an rdfs:label for that domain node, and an rdfs:comment saying it is an unsigned draft, not published.

HONESTY RULES, which are what this record is for:
- Every literal longer than a line must be traceable: name the locator it came from, in the literal or via prov:wasDerivedFrom.
- Write no number that is not in the allowed list above.
- The claim's dct:description must state the finding's STATUS in words and must state what the finding does NOT establish.
- Do not reuse a description, label or comment you would write for a different finding. Shared boilerplate is the failure mode being measured.
- The record is UNSIGNED. Say so in the pubinfo rdfs:comment.

Output the TriG as the `trig` field and the locators you cited as `cited_locators`. No commentary.
